context.source: Explicit caller-supplied value; no block or freshness verified.

warnings: Offline inspection only: no chain state, simulation, sender or contract behavior verified.
Selectors can collide; an ABI pattern match does not prove ERC-20 behavior.
EIP-1559 arithmetic only; caller must establish that these rules apply to the supplied context.
Base fee is unverified input, not a live quote or prediction. Token destination does not change the native gas asset.
Ceilings use gasLimit, not gas used; actual gas charges, refunds, execution, balance, nonce, block limits and inclusion are unverified.
No sender is supplied. Value plus fee ceiling is arithmetic, not proof of funds or safety to sign.

gas.meaning: Lower bound only, not an estimate of EVM execution or gas used.

warnings: Offline inspection only: no chain state, simulation, sender or contract behavior verified.
Selectors can collide; an ABI pattern match does not prove ERC-20 behavior.
Explicit historical gas profile only; no activation, execution, base fee, block limits, balance, nonce, refunds or safety to sign checked. Passing is not transaction validity.

feeBudget.meaning: Gas limit times maximum fee per gas; excludes token transfers. Not an estimate.

warnings: Offline inspection only: no chain state, simulation, sender or contract behavior verified.
Selectors can collide; an ABI pattern match does not prove ERC-20 behavior.

limitations: Only original unsigned type-2 RLP or a complete unsigned JSON-RPC object is accepted.
Profile and chain are explicit caller choices; fork activation is not detected.
Fee, balance and nonce context are unauthenticated caller assertions; no freshness or account association is established.
Unsigned input has no recoverable sender; token contract state is not sender context.
Pending-window competition and nonce gaps are diagnostics, not fee-replacement policy checks.
Unchecked context stays null. Passing the listed constraints is not full validity, execution, inclusion or safety to sign.
Fingerprint is SHA-256 of normalized unsigned bytes, not an Ethereum transaction hash; JSON spelling is not fingerprinted.
